    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    while queue:
        path = queue.pop(0)
        node = path[-1]
        if node not in visited:
            neighbours = graph.get(node, [])
            next_nodes = [n for n in neighbours if n not in visited]

                new_path = list(path)
                new_path.append(neighbour)
                queue.append(new_path)
                if neighbour == goal:
                    return new_path
            visited.add(node)

def find_path(graph, start, goal):
    stack = []
    visited = set()
    recursion_limit = set()
    keep_track_of_path = []
    stack.append(start)
    visited.add(start)
    recursion_limit.add(start)
    keep_track_of_path.append(start)
    while stack:
        current_node = stack[-1]
        if current_node == goal:
            return keep_track_of_path
        neighbors = graph.get(current_node, [])
        next_nodes = [node for node in neighbors if node not in visited]
        if not next_nodes:
            stack.pop()
            visited.remove(stack[-1])
            recursion_limit.remove(stack[-1])
            keep_track_of_path.pop()
        else:
            next_node = next_nodes[0]
            stack.append(next_node)
            visited.add(next_node)
            recursion_limit.add(next_node)
            keep_track_of_path.append(next_node)
    return None

    stack = []

    stack.append(start)
    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()
        if current == goal:

            while current in visited:

                path.append(current)
            path.reverse()
            return path
        if current not in visited:
            visited[current] = 1
            stack.extend((neighbors for neighbors in graph[current] if neighbors not in visited))
